example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বক্তৃতা অমৃতং সুভাষিতম, সকলে মুগ্ধ হয়ে গেল।
পুরাতন গ্রন্থে বলা হয়েছে, অমৃতং সুভাষিতম, তাই সত্যবাদী কথা সর্বদা মূল্যবান।
example_sentences_in_english: His speech was like nectar, well-spoken; everyone was enchanted.
Ancient texts say, well-spoken words are nectar, so truthful speech is always valuable.
history: This Sanskrit proverb originates from ancient Indian literature, such as the Subhashita genre, which collects wise sayings; it draws from Vedic and Puranic traditions where amrita symbolizes immortality and divine essence.
note: This idiom is more common in formal or literary Bengali contexts influenced by Sanskrit, less in everyday colloquial speech.
